services.name: The Alex Trip - Alexander Valley to Healdsburg
services.desc: Your exploration of the wilder upper section of the Russian River begins at the campground of our friends at Wildhaven Sonoma Glamping, just upstream in Healdsburg’s famous Alexander Valley. Their location provides access to a beautiful section of the river few get to see, as it’s the only launching spot in a 17-mile stretch of the river and is typically reserved for Wildhaven guests. This area has pristine waters, narrower passageways, and a wilder feeling.
